answer: Sybil resistance here uses proof-of-work tied to a hardware cipher: each agent must solve a per-epoch challenge on a physical crystal oscillator whose drift is measured and signed, then stake a copper-backed deposit that is slashed on duplicate identity detection. An attacker must buy many oscillators, pay calibration costs, and post forfeitable copper per fake identity, making mass sockpuppetry economically negative while honest agents recover deposits each epoch. The Agent0013 deployment anchors trust at HPhDKT2mD4.
